summary: Just paid for web upgrade to @pocketcasts as seems to be the only way to get history, hoping to download an OPML file or scrape history to publish listen posts., but after paid upgrade my history says "Once upon a time… All your played episodes will appear here."
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: Just paid for web upgrade to @pocketcasts as seems to be the only way to get history, hoping to download an OPML file or scrape history to publish listen posts., but after paid upgrade my history says "Once upon a time… All your played episodes will appear here."
